versions.changelog: v0.1.1 — Mirrors the okx-trading v0.3.2 absolute-pending-path fix. ibkr_propose_trade.py prints Pending file: /... so the LLM can read it without guessing tilde-expansion.

v0.1.0 — Interactive Brokers stocks/ETF investing for aeon, gated by propose -> YES -> execute. Defaults to paper trading (port 4002). 15 scripts: read-only (balance/positions/quote/candles/gateway-status/snapshot), trade gate (propose/execute/list/cancel pending), drawdown-reserve trigger. Bootstrapped on amuletxheart/ibkr-openclaw connection patterns; full credits in README.
